summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal rulings and regulatory developments impacting the retail and tech sectors in India, alongside notable corporate earnings.

bullets.text: Tahir Hussain sentenced to 2 years in jail for abetment in Delhi riots case.
Urban Company reports Q2 revenue rise of 41% to Rs 537 crore; board approves fundraise of up to Rs 2,500 crore.
Crompton Greaves reports a 65% profit surge to Rs 124 crore for Q2.
Cult.fit receives Sebi approval for IPO comprising fresh issue of up to Rs 950 crore.
Mukesh Ambani's Jio seeks $108 billion valuation in its upcoming IPO.
